  [12] File: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (line ~2673)
      Problem: The redirection `2>&1 >/dev/null` inside the subshell captures stderr into `merge_err` while discarding stdout. However, if `gh_retry` (the wrapper) writes its own retry logs/headers to stdout, those are lost, and only the `gh` command's stderr is captured. More importantly, there is no length capping on `merge_err`.; If the `gh pr merge` command outputs a massive error log (e.g., thousands of lines of check failure details), the `merge_err` variable will be huge. This is then passed to `jq` and eventually stored in the state file and posted as a comment. GitHub comments have a 65,536-character limit; a huge error string can cause `post_state_comment` or `post_tracking_comment` to fail, potentially stalling the poller or causing data loss in the state file.
      Confidence: avg 4.0
      Flagged by: google_gemini-3-flash-preview
